set_text.text: Inventory turnover counts how many times a year the stock on your floor is sold and bought again. It measures the speed of the shelf, not the size of it. At this calculator's defaults, the shelf empties and refills 12.0 times a year.
Speed, weighted by dollars. Every line feeds the same 12.0 turns, and the lines holding the most cost pull it hardest.
Profit. A line can turn fast and earn little, or turn slowly at a margin worth waiting for. Turns say how fast, not how well.
Items you stock for a single customer turn at that customer's pace. When that customer stops ordering one, the stock stops moving and still sits inside the average.
Who uses an inventory turnover ratio calculator
It is built for independent food distributors who want to know how hard their stock is working. Owners, finance and buying teams use it to set targets and to spot cash sitting still.
